<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Orikalka </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/982264010873376868.png?v=1" alt="orikalka" title="orikalka" kind="icon" /><nowiki> has already spawned, avoid getting aggro'd by hugging the West wall before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> East</nowiki></p>
